The opening of a strange portal in the Forest of Brotherhood. The threat of species that seemed far away now so close and so imminent. The Thorac which first may have been hesitant to take action were now riled up. The Saen which first watched the meeting of the Thorac tribes take place with mild disinterest and recommended less intense action being taken to protect the forest now seemed to murmur among each other. Representatives sent out messengers quickly to their tribes. The whole garden was a constant frenzy.

Mar'dy was rather unfazed. It was as if the Thorac forgot the constant turmoil of Gaea or something. Then again, they seemed to be rather young. He told Sa'vak along with a detachment of guards to watch the portal carefully. Of course mighty giant Saen were already doing this, but he trusted the instinct of his blood brother.

He began to organize himself into meetings of the Thorac representatives. They discussed the martial ability of each tribe, how and where training could take place. A security force had to be mobilized from the Thorac, and it shouldn't be done sloppily or ineffectively. There were also discussions with the Saen elders. They talked about how the barrier forest was made and how effective walls would need to be constructed. [Something that would be sturdy and easy to build but would not look out of place in the forest.](https://s-media-cache-ak0.pinimg.com/736x/b3/4a/2b/b34a2b2f932c01ed43be644b1009f042.jpg) (But imagine it taller)

As Mar'dy prepared to rest very late into the nice, a Flora ran into his tent. It was one of the guards from back in Kureta.

"M'Lord..." He said, very out of breath. He looked like he had been travelling and running for days with little break. His eyes were wide, he shivered and twitched. "In Kureta...monsters...they eat your mind...nobody is helping us...they hunt you if you leave...they hunt you if you stay!"
